references.text: Describes the remaining peoples who had not yet been driven out, which Joshua distributed as an inheritance to the tribes
Refers to the land that still remained to be taken, linked to the distribution of the inherited land
The borders of the promised land, including from the Jordan to the great sea (the Mediterranean) toward the west
The promise that every place their foot treads shall become theirs, from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river Euphrates to the western sea
God's promise to Joshua regarding the borders of the land, from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great sea toward the sunset
Joshua cast lots for the tribes and distributed the land as an inheritance, as referred to in the verse
The instruction to distribute the land by casting lots as an inheritance to the tribes according to their families
